For every simple bipartite graph $G$ , there is a polynomial $C_{G}\succeq 0$ 
with no terms of degree less than five such that

 $D_{G}=(D_{G})_{4}+Q_{G}+C_{G}.$

  · intro d
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, MvPolynomial.coeff_sub,
      MvPolynomial.coeff_homogeneousComponent]

    by_cases hd4 : Finsupp.degree d = 4
    · simp [hd4]
    · rw [if_neg hd4, hlow d (by omega)]
